name: update-notion-when-rescheduled-in-buttondown
is_private_note: VIOLATES repo rule 7 (new Zaps are account-visible, never private). The Durables UI migration tool created the container private, and visibility cannot be changed after creation — `update-workflow` takes only --name/--description and no publish command exposes a visibility flag. Fixing it means recreating the container with `create-workflow` (no --private) and republishing. Cheap here: the trigger is a poll, so there is no external catch URL to rewire. Not done yet — awaiting Dennis.

trigger.notes: Polling trigger on the private `Buttondown Unofficial #2` app (source: ~/Repos/zapier-buttondown). Polls GET /v1/emails?status=scheduled&ordering=-creation_date&page=1, keeps rows with a publish_date, and dedupes on `${id}:${publish_date}` so each reschedule is a fresh event. Emits `email_id` and `publish_date` (plus subject/body/status/slug), which is exactly what InputSchema reads. Durable triggers cannot set a polling interval, so this runs at the account default.

connection_notes.notioncliapi_connection: Legacy numeric id carried over by the migration tool; it is the work.flowers Notion connection (UUID 02b73654-15c8-85c3-b16a-07304d2beb17), the same one `new-buttondown-subscriber-update-in-notion` uses. Confirmed by the pinned NotionCLIAPI 2.39.1 (the Knoxx connection is on 2.32.0) and by that data source being visible from it. Never the `Knoxx | Dennis #2` connection (02b95b31-c152-8800-9036-1107e08f70da).
connection_notes.TableCLIAPI: search/find_record against Zapier Table 01KNJN2MSBAJVXRME6M1Y65F5B — Zapier Tables need no connection and cost no tasks.

notion.property_written: Send Date (date) via `properties|||Send Date|||date__start` with use_zapier_datetime_fields: true

fields.f1: Page ID (Notion Newsletter Issues page id)

known_issues: Unguarded empty lookup: `tableFindRecord.data[0].old.data.f1` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'old')` when the Buttondown email has no mapping row. find_record returns `{data: []}` on no match. Reproduced 2026-08-07 with run-durable run 019fdb87-d810-7abb-9e91-d95c4b2b1c4d — the step retried and would have exhausted all 5 attempts. Fires for any email scheduled directly in Buttondown rather than via the Notion 'Send to Buttondown' button. Fix: return a skip when data is empty.
Missing the repo rule 2 source-of-truth header comment in the deployed source.

workflow.ts does not typecheck under --strict: line 46 indexes `Record<string, unknown>` and then reads `.old.data.f1` off `unknown` (TS2571). Harmless at run time (the runtime transpiles without checking) but the cast should be tightened.
InputSchema is declared but never parsed — it only feeds `z.infer`. No runtime validation of the trigger payload.
description: Buttondown reschedule -> Notion Newsletter Issues Send Date. Migrated from the classic Zapier UI to a Durable via the Durables UI migration tool (2026-08-07); stored here as deployed, unmodified.
